items.title: From preparedness to response: EU Reference Laboratories for Public Health in action
items.content_text: Strong laboratory capacity is the backbone of Europe’s preparedness in the face of increasing communicable disease threats, said ECDC on the occasion of today’s European Laboratory Day, celebrated every year on 5 November to recognise the essential contribution of laboratory professionals across Europe.

items.content_text: The first cycle of Public Health Emergency Preparedness Assessments (PHEPAs) coordinated by the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) has shown a strong commitment to emergency preparedness across Europe, with a number of common challenges remaining.

items.title: As the cold season nears, universal immunisation of newborns against RSV could significantly reduce infant hospitalisations across Europe
items.content_text: As the season for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and other respiratory diseases approaches, a new report from the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) indicates that universal immunisation of newborns against RSV could substantially reduce hospitalisations among infants linked to the disease during the winter season.

items.title: Strengthening public health emergency operations centres in Europe through exchange of good practices
items.content_text: A three-day training workshop organised by ECDC and WHO/Europe and hosted by the Slovenian National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) brought together participants from the EU and a number of accession countries to strengthen their national Public Health Emergency Operations Centres (PHEOCs) and to ensure they operate in line with EU and international standards.

items.title: Postcard from the field: Supporting outbreak preparedness in South Sudan - two EPIET fellows in the field
